description: Date when the claim was adjudicated and payment decision was made. Used for turnaround time reporting and prompt payment compliance.

description: Member's share of costs calculated as a percentage of the allowed amount after deductible is met. Represents cost-sharing between member and plan.

description: Fixed dollar amount the member pays for a covered service as defined in the benefit plan. Typically collected at time of service.

description: Boolean flag indicating whether this allocation is for a corrected or resubmitted claim. True if claim was corrected after initial submission.

description: Additional discount applied to the claim beyond standard contractual adjustments. May include prompt payment discounts or special negotiated rates.

description: Fiscal year to which this payment allocation is assigned for financial reporting and budgeting purposes.

description: General ledger account code to which this payment allocation is posted for financial accounting. Used for expense categorization and financial statement preparation.

reference: Financial Accounting Standards, Payment Processing Standards

reference: CMS Remittance Advice Remark Codes (RARC), ANSI X12 835

reference: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

description: Four-digit code used on institutional claims (UB-04) to identify the type of accommodation, ancillary service, or billing calculation. Used for facility payment allocation.
Boolean flag indicating whether this allocation represents a reversal of a previous payment. True if reversal transaction.

description: Boolean flag indicating whether this claim contributes to risk adjustment calculations for Medicare Advantage or ACA marketplace programs. True if risk-adjustable.
reference: CMS Risk Adjustment Model, HHS-HCC Risk Adjustment

description: Start date of the service period for which payment is being allocated. For single-day services, matches service_date_to.
End date of the service period for which payment is being allocated. For single-day services, matches service_date_from.
Boolean flag indicating whether this payment allocation is subject to subrogation recovery from a third party liable for the member's injury or illness. True if subrogation applies.
reference: ERISA Subrogation Rights, State Subrogation Laws

description: Nine-digit Tax Identification Number (EIN or SSN) of the provider entity receiving payment. Used for tax reporting and payment reconciliation.
reference: IRS Tax Identification Number Requirements, CMS Provider Enrollment

description: Code classifying the general category of service (medical, surgical, diagnostic, etc.). Used for utilization reporting and payment categorization.
Number of service units originally billed by the provider for this claim line. Represents quantity of service requested for payment.
Number of service units paid for this claim line. May differ from units billed if payment is reduced or denied. Units represent quantity of service (visits, days, procedures, etc.).
reference: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

description: Boolean flag indicating whether this allocation includes value-based payment components such as quality incentives or shared savings. True if value-based, false if standard FFS.

reference: Value-Based Care Contracting Standards, CMS Alternative Payment Models

description: Boolean flag indicating whether services are related to a workers compensation claim. True if workers comp related, affecting payment responsibility.

Identifier of the payment batch in which this scheduled payment is grouped for processing. Enables batch-level tracking and reconciliation.

Classification of the bank account type for electronic payment disbursement (checking, savings, business accounts).
Nine-digit ABA routing transit number identifying the financial institution for electronic payment processing.

Unique check number assigned when payment method is paper check. Used for payment tracking and reconciliation.
Human-readable claim number assigned by the claims administration system. Used for member and provider communication regarding payment schedules.
Classification of the claim type for which this payment is scheduled (e.g., medical, pharmacy, dental, vision, behavioral health).

description: Classification of this payers responsibility level in coordination of benefits scenarios (primary, secondary, tertiary).
reference: NAIC Model COB Regulation, ANSI X12 837

description: Date and time when this payment schedule record was initially created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

Employer or group identifier under which the member is enrolled. Used for payment allocation and employer reporting.
reference: ANSI X12 834 Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance

description: Boolean flag indicating whether this scheduled payment is currently on hold and should not be processed. Used for payment suspension pending investigation or resolution.
The date on which the payment hold was placed. Used for tracking hold duration and aging analysis.
Code indicating the reason why the payment is on hold (e.g., fraud investigation, member request, provider dispute, coordination of benefits pending).

The date on which the payment hold was released and the payment was cleared for processing.
Interest amount calculated and added to the payment due to delayed payment processing beyond regulatory or contractual timeframes.

description: Classification of the insurance product line under which the claim and payment are processed (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Marketplace).

Date and time when this payment schedule record was last modified. Used for tracking changes and data currency.
Amount deducted from the scheduled payment to recover prior overpayments or other obligations owed by the payee.

Standard code indicating the reason for payment offset (e.g., prior overpayment recovery, recoupment, third-party liability).

Federal Tax Identification Number of the payee entity. Required for IRS reporting and payment processing compliance.

description: Classification of the recipient entity type receiving this scheduled payment (e.g., healthcare provider, member for reimbursement, facility, third-party vendor).
reference: ANSI X12 835 Healthcare Payment and Remittance Advice

description: First line of the mailing address where payment check or correspondence should be sent. Primary street address component.
Second line of the payment mailing address for suite numbers, apartment numbers, or additional address details.
Total amount of adjustments applied to the scheduled payment amount. Represents the difference between scheduled and actual payment amounts.

description: Standard code indicating the reason for payment adjustment (e.g., offset, recoupment, coordination of benefits, prior overpayment recovery).
reference: ANSI X12 835 Claim Adjustment Reason Codes (CARC)

description: Detailed text description explaining the reason for the payment adjustment. Provides context beyond the standard reason code.
City name component of the payment mailing address.
Confirmation number provided by the payment processor upon successful payment processing. Used for payment verification and inquiry.
Three-letter ISO country code for the payment mailing address. Supports international payment processing.
Three-letter ISO currency code indicating the currency in which the payment will be disbursed (e.g., USD for US Dollars).
Code indicating the payment instrument or mechanism to be used for disbursement (e.g., ACH for Automated Clearing House, EFT for Electronic Funds Transfer, CHECK for paper check).
Free-text notes providing additional context, instructions, or special handling requirements for this scheduled payment.
Email address to which payment notification and remittance advice should be sent. Used for electronic payment communication.
Phone number for payment notification and inquiry. Used for payee contact regarding payment status and issues.
Priority level assigned to this scheduled payment for processing queue management (e.g., urgent for prompt payment compliance, normal for standard processing).
The date on which the payment processing batch was executed. Represents the business date of the payment cycle.
Sequential number indicating the order of this payment installment within the overall payment schedule (e.g., 1 for first payment, 2 for second payment).

Current status of this scheduled payment installment indicating its position in the payment lifecycle from scheduling through final disbursement or cancellation.
Description of the payment terms and schedule agreed upon for this claim (e.g., Net 30, installment plan details, payment frequency).
